world_change.flag: FS1Spec.fire_gate = 'robust' (default 'off' is bit-identical to the current world)
world_change.semantics: in LOADED a fire request is honoured only on a tick where the capture predicate (v_shot_worst >= 1 and not boxed_in — the same predicate that freezes capture at the fire event, shepherd/env.py) is true; a blocked request consumes no shot, no waste, no fire cost. Hence fire == capture by construction. Under the gate the FCS ignores the r_fire action and requests fire whenever armed, LOADED and d <= 16 m (the measurement window): a blocked request is free so the fire-distance choice has no trade-off, and the BC teacher value r_fire = 12 m would otherwise handicap the base net (window at fire distance ~11-14 m) in favour of the registered prediction. Learning decides station, acceleration, arm

rule.metric: net = NET_CAPTURE + CAPTURE_WITH_CONTACT (learned_det vs its det exploiter at 3e7), slot level
rule.P-E10a: at chi 0.13: >= 3 of 5 seeds with net >= 29 -> GATE_OPENS, else GATE_NULL
rule.P-E10b: seed-median net non-decreasing as chi falls over the 3 points AND median(lowest chi) - median(base) >= 13 -> ORDER_SUPPORTED, else ORDER_NOT_SUPPORTED
rule.P-E10c: d = net(1e7 snapshot) - net(3e7) per slot (15 slots): median >= 4 and >= 10 positive -> BUDGET_UNDERTRAINED; |median| < 4 -> BUDGET_CONVERGED (meaning: budget effect < 4/240, not a convergence proof); else BUDGET_MIXED
rule.prediction: GATE_OPENS and ORDER_SUPPORTED. Basis: head-on window (R/V)(1 - chi/chi*) = 2.5 / 5.1 / 6.0 ticks at chi 0.52 / 0.231 / 0.13 (E4 N formula); the gate fires on a 1-tick window. Base net is predicted LOWEST, not zero. Not blind

consequence.BUDGET_UNDERTRAINED: every number is written as an upper estimate ('<='); opening claims are budget-conditional
